EC1: - Hypersensitivity to any of the study treatments
EC2: - Clearly defined predominant [OR] or sole trigger of their chronic urticaria (chronic inducible urticaria)
EC3: - Other diseases with symptoms of urticaria [OR] or angioedema
EC4: - Other skin disease associated with chronic itching that might influence in the investigators opinion the study evaluations and results,
EC5: - Known or suspected history of an ongoing, chronic [OR] or recurrent infectious disease including but not limited to opportunistic infections (eg tuberculosis, atypical mycobacterioses, [OR] listeriosis [OR] or aspergillosis), HIV, [OR] Hepatitis B/ [OR] C.
EC7: - Women [AND] of child-bearing potential [NOT] not using highly effective methods of contraception
EC8: Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply.
